meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去检索你过往会话的记忆库:先给你一张带 ID 的索引表,你挑出相关的几条,它再取回完整细节,而不是一次全拉出来。
howto.when: 当你问「这个问题我们之前解决过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」等关于以往会话的问题,或需要查看以前会话的工作时触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么修 authentication 的?
say.note: 先返回索引表,挑中后再取全文

say.text: 搜一下最近的 bugfix,项目 my-project
say.note: 可按类型、时间过滤搜索

say.text: 把 #11131 的完整内容取出来
say.note: 按 ID 批量拉取观察记录全文

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your persistent cross-session memory: it returns an index table with IDs, then fetches full details only for the entries you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask whether something was already solved or how it was done last time, or need work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: How did we fix authentication last time?
say_en.note: Returns an index first, then full details

say_en.text: Search recent bugfixes in project my-project
